label: Post-yield softening and rehardening sensitivity hypothesis
basis: Frozen manual hypothesis from the earlier short remeshed FE study, extended to the full requested domain without copying specimen force-displacement data. PLA post-yield softening is qualitatively reported by Scipioni and Lambiase (2023), https://doi.org/10.1007/s00170-023-11985-y ; this citation does not identify these parameters or establish their validity for this printed specimen. The descending local plastic law is mesh-dependent and unregularized; no independent validation or automatic promotion is claimed.
